text: ‘The large increase in global crime has been caused entirely by the spread of global capitalism.’
Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The consequences of globalisation for developing countries are entirely negative.’ Evaluate this
view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘Postmodernists are right in claiming that the media plays a central role in people’s lives today.’
Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘The media serves the interests of the ruling class.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘Religion is an obstacle to social change.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Growing support for new religious movements disproves the secularisation thesis.’ Evaluate this
view. [35]
